trailhead.label: Ranui car park, by the Waldschenke restaurant, the board’s start

cautions: Forest road shared with occasional service traffic near both ends.
Meadows around Zannes are farmed: keep your dog on the path.
Carry water even though water points are listed.
Follow local signs, lead rules and temporary closures.

emergency.note: Call the European emergency number when urgent help is required. Connectivity is not guaranteed.
